finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pptx-actions.ts::a single failing image fetch aborts the whole pptx export (pdf path degrades gracefully instead)

verdict.reasoning: Verified against the supplied sources: in `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pptx-actions.ts` the `fetchImage` callback calls `docsImageFetcher(src)` with no try/catch, and `docsImageFetcher` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/export-utils.ts) throws `Image fetch failed: ...` on any non-ok response. `exportPptx` (packages/slides/src/export/pptx/index.ts, Step 2 pre-scan loop) awaits `opts.fetchImage(src)` un-guarded, so the rejection propagates and the whole export fails — the button handler in slides-export-button.tsx then shows only "Export failed". The contrast with the PDF path is also correct: `resolveDeckImages` in packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts wraps `await fetcher(src)` in try/catch and substitutes `BLANK_PNG`. So the claim is accurate; the only nuance is that failing loudly is a defensible design choice (a missing image would otherwise silently vanish from the deck), which keeps the impact moderate rather than severe.
